findings.expected: Open the saved draft review, or provide an authentication flow that resumes review.

click_path: Read policy status and the exception form
findings.expected: Clearly distinguish submission readiness from required approval exceptions and identify the relevant exception.
findings.actual: The page simultaneously displays 'pass', 'Ready for submit', and a local overnight waiver requirement. The exception selector defaults to 'advance_booking' despite the displayed issue being 'local_overnight'.
findings.fix_hint: Explain the outstanding waiver and its effect on approval, and preselect or directly link to the relevant exception type.
fix_hints: Explain the outstanding waiver and its effect on approval, and preselect or directly link to the relevant exception type.
Use matching field labels, link errors to their inputs, and explicitly mark cost center optional in recovery guidance.
Map validation codes to visible labels, focus the first invalid control, and mark required inputs before submit
Promote the human questions into per-field error text adjacent to each textbox and aria-describedby links
Remove the receipt size input from the UI and compute it automatically on the frontend or backend during receipt upload.
Hide the JSON payload preview from standard user views, or place it behind a 'Debug Details' toggle restricted to admins/developers.
Group fields into logical sections, use progressive disclosure for optional details, clearly distinguish required from optional

findings.element: Submitted answers and canonical payload preview
click_path: Review submitted trip details before submission
findings.expected: Provide a concise, grouped trip summary that makes important details and outstanding actions easy to verify.
findings.actual: The review presents a long list of internal field paths, including 'flight_pref_outbound.roundtrip_cost' and 'comparable_hotels[0].nightly_rate', followed by a JSON payload repeating much of the same information.
findings.fix_hint: Group details into traveler, itinerary, costs, and policy sections using readable labels; place the technical payload behind an optional disclosure.
fix_hints: Group details into traveler, itinerary, costs, and policy sections using readable labels; place the technical payload behind an optional disclosure.
Stage the workflow into required trip brief first, then optional air/lodging and policy sections after draft save
Replace byte/reference inputs with file upload and auto-populate receipt metadata after OCR
Implement a 'Select Approved Trip' picker that fetches the user's active trips and automatically populates the underlying system IDs.
Pre-fill defaults, reduce mandatory fields, add quick-entry options for common trip types
